 Coach Paul Assaiante – Leading People to Greatness (Capital Allocators, EP.307) 
 
 Coach Paul Assaiante – Leading People to Greatness (Capital Allocators, EP.307) Apr 10, 2023

 Coach Paul Assaiante is the
winningest coach in college sports history. For 30 years until
announcing his retirement at the end of this season, Coach led the
Trinity College squash program to 17 national championships and 20
finals appearances in the last 25 years, including at one point
winning 252 straight matches and 13 straight national titles.

In his final season, Trinity’s squash team entered the national
championships with the #6 seed and rode an almost fairy tale
bookend to Coach’s career to the finals and within a single point
of an 18th national title. Paul also coached the USA National Team
in squash for 17 years, Trinity’s men’s tennis squad for 24 years,
and World Team Tennis with Billie Jean King in its heyday. In 2010,
he authored Run to the Roar: Coaching to Overcome Fear, 
one of my favorite books on sports and leadership.

Perhaps what is most fascinating about the soft-spoken Coach is he
knew nothing about squash when he got his first coaching job. His
true expertise is in managing, motivating, and inspiring a diverse
group of players to be the best version of themselves.

Our conversation covers Coach Paul’s path and a career’s worth of
wisdom about preparation, emotional regulation, managing high
performing individuals on a team, diversity, facing fear, learning
to win and lose, and applying the lessons to the business world and
next generation.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
